name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Qwen FP8)
notes: Fast MoE with 3B active, Qwen's own FP8 checkpoint. The settings come from a single-Spark Easypanel service that ran it well (spark-arena nightly image, FlashInfer attention, decode-only CUDA graphs, Mamba cache align). No --moe-backend: vLLM picks one for FP8. That service also used YaRN x2 for 512k context and its own sampling (temperature 0.1, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, repetition_penalty 1.1, presence_penalty 0.15); here the context is the native 256k and clients choose the sampling. Unsloth's NVFP4 variants did not start on DGX Spark with vLLM 0.29.1 and flashinfer_b12x (the regular one has FP8 experts, which b12x refuses; the Fast one crashed with an illegal memory access), 2026-10-09. Fits on one Spark; with two it is split across both. Not yet run here.
